description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Pinnacle Monk.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
